name: Mediterranean Pasta Salad
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical 350g dry pasta pasta salad recipes (85-90g dry per serving).
Total time is sum of sequential and overlapping steps: pasta boil ~10 min + prep ~15 min + mandatory 30 min rest.
Farfalle (bow-tie pasta) classified as wheat-based (Wheat and Gluten-free false).
Tuna classified as fish (Pescatarian true, Fish allergen).
No tree nuts, peanuts, shellfish, eggs, soy, or sesame listed.
Salt and pepper estimates based on provided data; do not affect classifications.
instructions:
Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil
Add the pasta, stir once and cook for about 10 minutes or as directed on the packet.
Meanwhile, wash the tomatoes and cut into quarters. Slice the olives. Wash the basil.
Put the tomatoes into a salad bowl and tear the basil leaves over them. Add a tablespoon of olive oil and mix.
When the pasta is ready, drain into a colander and run cold water over it to cool it quickly.
Toss the pasta into the salad bowl with the tomatoes and basil.
Add the sliced olives, drained mozzarella balls, and chunks of tuna. Mix well and let the salad rest for at least half an hour to allow the flavours to mingle.
Sprinkle the pasta with a generous grind of black pepper and drizzle with the remaining olive oil just before serving.

ingredients.name: mozzarella balls
ingredients.assumptions: Drained fresh mozzarella balls; typical values for cow's milk mozzarella.

ingredients.name: baby plum tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Raw baby plum tomatoes; standard tomato nutrition applied to whole edible weight.

ingredients.name: fresh basil
ingredients.assumptions: 1 bunch fresh basil estimated at 30 g edible leaves only (stems discarded); typical fresh basil values.

ingredients.name: farfalle
ingredients.assumptions: Dry farfalle pasta as packaged; cooked in salted water but nutrition uses dry basis per standard practice.

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil (15 ml per tbsp, density ~0.91 g/ml yields ~41-45 g total); pure oil values.

ingredients.name: Green Olives
ingredients.assumptions: Drained green olives; typical pitted olive nutrition.

ingredients.name: tuna
ingredients.assumptions: Drained canned tuna in water or brine (edible portion after draining); typical skipjack values.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.assumptions: Salt to taste estimated at 5 g total for the recipe (reasonable for pasta water and seasoning); contributes negligible macros.

ingredients.name: pepper
ingredients.assumptions: Black pepper to taste estimated at 2 g total for generous grind; contributes negligible macros.
